findings.text: the fixture redirects RECKON_HOME to a test-config home but never asserts the live crew home was left untouched, so a broken home resolution would write a fixture pointer into the real directory; the repository test rule names that assertion for every write-shaped test.

item_verdicts.diff: read the two commits against base 6eda430c; the combined diff is 263 insertions and 1 deletion across exactly the four declared paths, the deletion being the revised plan-verifies meta line.
item_verdicts.done_when: read tests/test_manifest_check_command.py lines 70-117; all four assertions drive CliRunner over crew check-manifest, and negative-control.txt:1 carries the declared mutation verbatim with the out-of-fence case observed red.
item_verdicts.goal: read reckon/cli.py crew check-manifest; it reads the run's live pointer, rebuilds the node it records through the resumption helper, delegates to audit_manifest with that node and exits 1 on any finding, which creates the first production caller.
item_verdicts.manifest: read the manifest; it records 5 passed for the named file, the four-file cohort at 2 failed 118 passed attributed to tests/test_removed_flag_migration.py as out of scope, the red log path, and no blockers.

justifications.durability: tests/test_manifest_check_command.py:109 fails if a second production caller of audit_manifest appears, and line 86 fails if the fence comparison stops reaching the command.

justifications.fit: reckon/cli.py imports the private helper _recorded_task_node across a module boundary, while otherwise matching the surface's lazy-import idiom.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/cli.py crew check-manifest performs exactly the delegation the goal names, and its census test proves the caller relation rather than describing it.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path the change touches is inside the declared fence, and the two doc edits are the landing record the plan itself requires.
